outcomes.route: ripple CRD through farmer B, trust-line flags as created
outcomes.enforced_by: nobody: B's issuer line is created without NoRipple
outcomes.note: B NoRipple: issuer line=False, A line=True. DepositAuth alone does not stop transfers to B, and B signs nothing

outcomes.route: same, after NoRipple is set on B's issuer line
outcomes.enforced_by: L1: NoRipple on both of B's lines
outcomes.note: B NoRipple: issuer line=True, A line=True

outcomes.route: same, after B clears that NoRipple again
outcomes.enforced_by: nobody on L1: B controls its own NoRipple flag
outcomes.note: like S5, the hardening holds only if the farmer cannot sign

outcomes.route: farmer clears own DepositAuth, then farmer -> farmer
outcomes.enforced_by: nobody on L1: depends on who holds the farmer's key

outcomes.route: farmer sells credit for XRP on the open DEX, farmer buys
outcomes.enforced_by: nobody on L1: offers bypass DepositAuth
outcomes.note: credit converted to cash: the diversion the restriction exists to stop

outcomes.route: farmer places an offer in the vendor-only permissioned DEX
outcomes.note: but S6a stays open: a domain restricts its own book, not the token

outcomes.route: control: vendor places an offer in the same domain

outcomes.note: vendor accepts CRD and hands over cash instead of inputs; the ledger records an ordinary farmer -> vendor payment (identical to S1)

outcomes.route: issuer freezes farmer A's line; A -> vendor
outcomes.note: also blocks legitimate spending: a blunt instrument

outcomes.route: issuer claws back 5 CRD from farmer A
outcomes.note: recovers diverted credit only if it is still on A's line; the issuer can take any holder's balance
